title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - InBodyWearable
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/InBodyWearable. A wearable device located inside the physical body of its Wearer (e.g. an implanted continuous glucose monitor). Subclass of WearableDevice per the SAREF4WEAR ontology; inherited properties (dimensions, hasInterface, hasPowerSupply, etc.) are documented on the WearableDevice model and not repeated here. Its own defining axiom is the isLocatedIn relationship (a sub-property of WearableDevice.isLocated) to a Wearer.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'InBodyWearable'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

isLocatedIn.description: Relationship. The Wearer inside whose body this wearable is located (s4wear:isLocatedIn, sub-property of isLocated). Links to a Wearer entity.
